author: Business Insider
description:
At 91, 80, and 79, Thelma, Carol, and Tom are still setting new goals and pushing their limits. Thelma learned to swim at 50, Carol found independence through table tennis, and Tom is taking on powerlifting for the first time. In "Never Too Late," we follow these three seniors as they prepare for and compete in the National Senior Games, challenging expectations of aging and showing how sports can offer something more than medals: a sense of purpose, independence, and community.

Watch our complete collection of Business Insider Docs: https://bit.ly/4AdCgxh

01:20 - Meet Tom: Taking on Powerlifting at 79
04:03 - Meet Thelma: Learning to Swim at 50
06:50 - Meet Carol: Finding Independence Through Table Tennis
08:20 - Challenges of Growing Older
10:04 - Preparing for the National Senior Games
12:39 - The Competition 
15:56 - What Winning Really Means
17:54 - Why It's Never Too Late
25:14 - Credits
